result.topic_en: Euler states that the summation formulas for the double series q^m (sums of 1/k^m times partial sums of 1/j^n) hold only when the order m+n=λ is odd, defines p^λ as the zeta-type sums, and begins the case where m is even.
result.transcription:
184 \quad MEDITATIONES CIRCA
Termini autem harum aequationum non vltra formulam $p^{\lambda-2}$, quae vltimum praebet terminum, continuari debent.

37. Hae autem ſummationes locum non habent, niſi exponens ordinis $m+n=\lambda$ fuerit numerus impar: ideoque harum aequationum ope ſummas omnium ſerierum in hac forma contentarum
$q^m = 1+\frac{1}{2^m}(1+\frac{1}{2^n})+\frac{1}{3^m}(1+\frac{1}{2^n}+\frac{1}{3^n})+\frac{1}{4^m}(1+\frac{1}{2^n}+\frac{1}{3^n}+\frac{1}{4^n})$ etc.
exhibere licet, ſi modo $m+n=\lambda$ ſit numerus impar. Iſtae autem ſummae definiuntur per ſummas poteſtatum reciprocarum, quas littera $p$ ſequenti modo repraeſento vt ſit
$p^\lambda = 1+\frac{1}{2^\lambda}+\frac{1}{3^\lambda}+\frac{1}{4^\lambda}+\frac{1}{5^\lambda}+$ etc. atque
$p^m \cdot p^n = (1+\frac{1}{2^m}+\frac{1}{3^m}+\frac{1}{4^m}+\text{etc.})(1+\frac{1}{2^n}+\frac{1}{3^n}+\frac{1}{4^n}+\text{etc.})$
Duos autem hic caſus diſtingui oportet, prout $m$ fuerit numerus vel par vel impar; habebitur enim

I. Caſu quo $m$ eſt numerus par
$q^m = p^m \cdot p^n + \tfrac{1}{2}(1+\lambda(n))p^\lambda \left.\begin{matrix}+0(n-1)\\+0(m-1)\end{matrix}\right\} p \left.\begin{matrix}+2(n-1)\\+2(m-1)\end{matrix}\right\} p^3 \left.\begin{matrix}+4(n-1)\\+4(m-1)\end{matrix}\right\} p^5$
$\left.\begin{matrix}+6(n-1)\\+6(m-1)\end{matrix}\right\} p^7 \ldots\ldots \left.\begin{matrix}+(\lambda-3)(n-1)\\+(\lambda-3)(m-1)\end{matrix}\right\} p^{\lambda-2}$

II.

items.quote: Hae autem ſummationes locum non habent, niſi exponens ordinis $m+n=\lambda$ fuerit numerus impar
items.english: These summations do not hold unless the exponent of the order m+n=λ is an odd number.

items.quote: ideoque harum aequationum ope ſummas omnium ſerierum in hac forma contentarum ... exhibere licet, ſi modo $m+n=\lambda$ ſit numerus impar.
items.english: Hence by means of these equations the sums of all series contained in this form can be exhibited, provided m+n=λ is odd.
